text.p: Infrastructure Trust of Australia said on Wednesday it was considering a further capital raising in calendar 1997.
"It is something we are contemplating," said trust manager John Caldon when asked if the trust was considering a capital raising.
Caldon said any raising would possibly be in 1997 and would be used for further acquisitions in railway, electricity and gas assets.
Infrastructure Trust of Australia (ITA) earlier reported a net profit of A$27.9 million for the year to June 30, its maiden reporting year. The distribution was 5.5 cents per stapled security.
ITA said its net operating profit compared with a prospectus forecast of A$15.3 million, while the distribution compared with a forecast of 5.3 cents per stapled security.
The Trust is managed by Macquarie Bank unit, Macquarie Infrastructure Investment Management Ltd.
